title: Microsoft Teams Rooms and shared devices: passwordless sign-in for Entra resource accounts
summary: The briefing passes: Microsoft documents the optional migration, device prerequisites, licensing requirements and all three portal paths. The password-cleanup permissions and limitations are accurately qualified. The checklist also recommends manual password resets that have no corresponding controls-table entry.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Security & identity; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Migration does not remove the resource-account password from Entra ID.
claims.quote: After a Teams device transitions to password-less authentication, its resource account password remains in Microsoft Entra ID, but the device no longer uses that password to sign in.

claims.claim: A migrated device remains signed in if the resource-account password changes.
claims.quote: If the resource account password is modified the device will remain signed in unlike prior to the transition where the device would be signed out.

claims.claim: Microsoft says authentication to Teams, Intune and the Pro Management portal does not change.
claims.quote: Authentication to Microsoft 365 services (Teams, Intune, Pro Management Portal, etc) does not change.

claims.quote: Removes resource accounts from meeting chats after the call ends

claims.claim: Set as Resource removes access to shared files.

claims.claim: Microsoft recommends cleanup or manual password rotation after migration.
claims.quote: We recommend that IT administrators use the cleanup steps or manually rotate the password after the transition to ensure that the password is unknown and secure.

claims.claim: The account password remains a credential after migration until it is reset or scrambled.
claims.quote: its resource account password remains in Microsoft Entra ID, but the device no longer uses that password to sign in. Reset or scramble the password to a complex, secure value that isn't known or retained by an administrator.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: An administrative-unit-scoped Password Administrator can reset passwords only for nonadministrator accounts in that unit.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance: After rollout

claims.where: Governance guidance: After rollout; Governance controls table

claims.quote: Checklist: reset or scramble the password in the source directory ... change the password of federated accounts through the identity provider. Table: Schedule migration; built-in Cleanup password; Set as Resource.
claims.fix: Remove the two manual-password-reset sentences from the After rollout checklist bullet, leaving 'Run Cleanup password for migrated cloud-managed accounts.' Keep the qualified source-directory and federated-password guidance in Risk assessment; do not add control rows.
